name: General Research Pack
description: General-purpose research workflow: mission execution, dataset build, offer packaging, approval, and ZIP export. Runs the standard biomedical prefetch + citation-integrity gate; a topic that yields no groundable biomedical evidence is BLOCKED by the gate (INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE), not shipped. SELLABLE as the Scoped Research Pack ($4,950, added 2026-08-12) for a BIOMEDICAL question — bounded to one question at fixed depth. Still NOT for sale as a general/NON-biomedical research product: the gate is a biomedical citation gate, so a non-biomedical topic yields no groundable PMID/NCT/ChEMBL/DOI and is blocked as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. NOTE on Q9/Q26 (2026-07-10 questionnaire): Q9's stated 'current reality' is STALE — it described this template as lacking a quality_check step, prefetch, and a working citation gate. Verified 2026-08-12: quality_audit step present (pipeline identical to trial-design-benchmark), prefetch live (scout 7 sources / analyst 5 / synthesizer 1), and minGroundedCitationRatio = 0.75 fail-closed. Of Q9's four options, 're-engineer to feed real prefetch queries' was the one taken.

pipeline.description_template: Quality gate: citation-density confidence (>= 0.6) plus >= 5 verified citations and per-section primary-source coverage; halts the run (PHASE30_QUALITY_BELOW_THRESHOLD) if the report is under-evidenced.
